corrects_v1_bugs: classify_evidence_strength() substring false-positive ('confirmed' matched inside 'unconfirmed' and inside 'neither confirmed') -- v2 uses explicit hand-authored (strength, supports_index) triples per evidence item instead of inferring from substrings

hp_status collapse logic never actually checked agreement across STRONG evidence despite the v1 code comment claiming it did -- v2 requires all STRONG items seen so far to agree on the same alternative, and correctly stays PRESERVE_BRANCHES when STRONG evidence disagrees (a real case v1 could not represent)
honest_scope_statement: Real 10-node multi-process coordination over a genuinely multi-tick, multi-scope task graph (5 regional/domain scopes + GLOBAL, 6 ticks, GWT broadcast/uptake each tick). The Hyperposition collapse/preserve state is computed by THIS DRIVER from hand-authored evidence strength/direction labels, not by the small model -- the model's role is answering short completion prompts per task as its 'sensing' contribution, separately recorded but NOT the source of the collapse decision.
